learnings.insight: AC-10 wall-clock measurements are invalid if transport keys are pressed while focus remains on the seek range (interactive exemption). Measuring 2×/4× required clicking the canvas (or the Speed button) before timing.
learnings.action: Before replay keyboard timing smokes, focus a non-interactive target or drive speed via the Speed control click.

learnings.insight: AC-17 cannot be forced in stock Chromium Playwright because MediaRecorder is present; residual is acceptable when pickExportMime(null path) is unit-tested and the UI error string is wired on null MIME.
learnings.action: Keep AC-17 as unit+wiring residual unless a stubbed MediaRecorder harness is added; do not fail implementer solely for missing unsupported-browser e2e.
